column1: # Spelling/punctuation conventions, applied by merge.py to every final subtitle (corrections included) and
# by the review tool when it fits typed text. pattern = Python regex, case-insensitive. The replacement
# takes the capital of what it replaces ("Dammit!" -> "Damn it!", "dammit" -> "damn it") when it starts
# lowercase; a replacement that starts with a capital ("Mr.") is always written as given, and one that
# starts with "=" is written exactly as given ("=weaps").
# Basis: the game's own text where it is clear, standard spelling otherwise, the user's picks where they
# were consistent (session 1). Spoken variants stay as spoken: c'mon/come on, gotta/got to, gonna, ya.

column3: standard; 184 vs 22 in the subtitles; user's picks

interrobang: any run of ? and ! as "?!" ("!?", "?!?")
